hypothesis: Once synthetic mechanism intensity is made PRE-learnable, a PRE-only adaptive convex mixture of C0_SCORE_PL and N1_CONDITIONAL can beat universal baselines on a synthetic design seed and then be frozen for disjoint-seed evaluation.
input_dataset: Learnable-regime Digital Twin v2 only. Design seed 20260917, 300 synthetic standard 7-rider races. Evaluation seed 20260918 was NOT ACCESSED because no design candidate qualified. No real/historical input.
prediction_method: 20 preregistered mappings w_hat=sigmoid(bias+slope*PRE_signal), with truth parameter pair deliberately excluded. PRE signal uses only wind speed, number of lines, and observed-score standard deviation. Baselines: C0_SCORE_PL, N1_CONDITIONAL, global mix 0.05, global mix 0.50. Hidden alpha/oracle/outcome/world label were excluded from prediction inputs.
conclusion: NO_DEVELOPMENT_ELIGIBLE_ADAPTIVE_MAPPING. The twin now contains a PRE-learnable mechanism, but the tested adaptive C0/N1 mixture family did not beat the best universal baseline overall. The nearest adaptive mapping improved the LOW stratum slightly but regressed MID/HIGH enough to remain worse overall. Evaluation was correctly left untouched. This rejects the specific assumption that making regime intensity learnable is sufficient when the adaptive component set itself is weak or misaligned.
scientific_implication: The next owner-free synthetic question is component adequacy, not more selector tuning. Audit how well C0 approximates the W0 oracle and N1 approximates the W2 oracle under matched PRE, especially by the learnable signal strata. If N1 is not materially closer to W2 than C0 in the relevant strata, build a separately preregistered spec-aligned conditional component before revisiting adaptive mixtures. Do not weaken V4 gates or access its evaluation seed as a rescue.
follow_up: Preregister a synthetic component-adequacy audit comparing C0 and N1 directly against W0/W2 oracle components by PRE signal strata. Keep V4 evaluation seed untouched. No selector rescue, no real evidence, no economics or promotion claim.
